newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent diesel prices track NYMEX lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent diesel prices track NYMEX lower.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent diesel fuel prices eased on Thursday, tracking lower NYMEX front-month heating oil futures in afternoon trade, traders said.
Unleaded differentials in the Chicago and Group Three spot markets were steady, leaving prices to track falling NYMEX April unleaded futures late in the day.
The market was unaffected by two barge accidents and a grounded freighter that restricted shipping traffic along key segments of the Mississippi River, traders said.
Low sulphur diesel for prompt deliveries remained 3.50/3.75 cents a gallon over NYMEX April heating oil in Group Three and 3.75/4.0 cents a gallon over the print in Chicago, traders said.
High sulphur diesel was talked 1.50/1.75 cents a gallon over the print in Group Three and 2.0/2.25 cents over the print in Chicago for all March timings, traders said.

Winter-grade unleaded in Chicago was heard done 7.15 cents a gallon under the print ahead of a seasonal changeover to summer-grade specifications. Summer-grade barrels were talked 3 cents a gallon under the print.
Group Three unleaded gasoline remained 3.75/3.50 cents a gallon under NYMEX April unleaded for prompt and late-March deliveries, traders said.
